findings.issue: The docstring says openness makes "the finite quotient `G ⧸ V` is discrete". `G` is only assumed `[IsTopologicalGroup G]`, with no compactness, so `IsOpen (V : Set G)` gives discreteness (`QuotientGroup.discreteTopology`) but not finiteness; the proof uses only discreteness.

summary: The 2-cocycle identity, the conjugation action, and the factor-set convention are all faithful, and the statements match the roadmap target. But `u_{G/V}(p)` is stated over a locally re-declared copy of the repo's canonical `Additive` coefficient structure, so the class does not live in the canonical H²; and the module docstring asserts finiteness of `G ⧸ V`, which the hypotheses do not give.
